data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 76.621m at 1 January 2015. Using the gross claims development table the syndicate shows favourable prior-year development of approximately GBP 6.28m (a release, ~8.2% of opening reserves), driven by reductions in the cumulative estimates for underwriting years 2011-2013. No single prior-year large loss is identified as the primary cause in the notes; the movement is reported via the claims development table and attributed to favourable claims development across older years.
raw_causal_phrases: The tables below show the Syndicate's cumulative incurred claims development, including both claims notified and IBNR for each underwriting year, together with the cumulative payments to date on a gross and net of reinsurance basis at the balance sheet date.
The provision for claims comprises amounts set aside for claims notified and claims incurred but not yet reported (IBNR).
The amount included in respect of IBNR is based on statistical techniques of estimation applied by external consulting actuaries.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position liabilities (Claims outstanding) 2014 comparative column. Prior-year development calculated from the gross claims development triangle (page 33) by comparing the latest diagonal vs prior diagonal for underwriting years 2011-2013 (excluded 2014 and 2015). No explicit single sentence quantifying gross prior-year movement was found; triangle-derived value used (confidence 0.8). Exact_reserve_text uses the table description as the report contains no explicit sentence summarising the gross prior-year movement. Premium mix taken from segmental analysis (page 21).
